messages.subject: Re: I can not install CODEX in latest R version(3.1.2)
messages.subject_clean: I can not install CODEX in latest R version(3.1.2)
messages.body_plain:
Dear Yuchao,

I tried to install CODEX on windows 8 using R- 3.1.2 and it gave the same error -  package ‘CODEX is not available (for R version 3.1.2)

I tried the second method as suggested, still it does't work and gave the error

Warning: invalid package 'CODEX_0.99.11.tar.gz'
Error: ERROR: no packages specified
Warning messages:
1: running command '"C:/Users/inna.mittal/Documents/R/R-3.1.2/bin/x64/R" CMD INSTALL -l "C:\Users\inna.mittal\Documents\R\R-3.1.2\library" "CODEX_0.99.11.tar.gz"' had status 1
2: In install.packages("CODEX_0.99.11.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type = "source") :
  installation of package ‘CODEX_0.99.11.tar.gz’ had non-zero exit status

I used the .zip file also, but it doesn't work.

Please suggest me some alternative.

Awaiting your reply

Thanks & regards,
Inna

On Wednesday, 4 March 2015 20:48:47 UTC+5:30, Yuchao Jiang wrote:
> Dear Song Li,
>
> We have a development version of CODEX via Bioconductor--this is a bit hectic as it needs R devel but it will bump up to a stabilized version in late March once Bioconductor is updated to 3.1 version. Although, I have not personally installed CODEX in R 3.1.3, I think if you follow the guidelines below (second option), it should work. Please let me know.
>
> Best,
> Yuchao
>
>
> Installation:
> If you have R devel (and devel Version of Bioconductor) <http://www.bioconductor.org/developers/how-to/useDevel/>, install directly from Bioconductor:
> source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
> biocLite("CODEX")
> biocLite("WES.1KG.WUGSC") # toy data package
> If you don't have R devel, download tarballs for both CODEX (CODEX_x.y.z.tar.gz <http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/html/CODEX.html>) and the toy dataset (WES.1KG.WUGSC_x.y.z.tar.gz <http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/devel/data/experiment/html/WES.1KG.WUGSC.html>) -- under Package Archives:
> # install depends: Rsamtools, GenomeInfoDb, and BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19
> source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
> biocLite("Rsamtools")
> biocLite("BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19")
> biocLite("GenomeInfoDb")
>
> # install toy data package
> install.packages('WES.1KG.WUGSC_x.y.z.tar.gz',repos=NULL,type='source')
>
> # install CODEX
> install.packages('CODEX_x.y.z.tar.gz',repos=NULL,type='source')
>
>
>
> > On Mar 4, 2015, at 9:28 AM, Zhang, Nancy <n...@wharton.upenn.edu> wrote:
> >
> >
> > Hi Yuchao,
> > Have we had issues with CODEX in R 3.1.3 before?  What would you suggest we try?
> > Nancy
> >
> > Sent from my iPhone
> >
> > On Mar 4, 2015, at 3:02 AM, li.song <li....@bgitechsolutions.com> wrote:
> >
> > > Mr./Ms. Zhang
> > >
> > > I am a researcher in BGI. I have read your paper
> > >
> > > CODEX: a normalization and copy number variation detection method for whole exome sequencing.
> > >
> > > And I follow the link: http://master.bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/html/CODEX.html and want to install CODEX. But I cannot successfully install CODEX on my cluster. Even I use the latest version of R program.
> > >
> > > The error message is “package 'CODEX' is not available (for R version 3.1.3 RC)”.
> > >
> > > You really do a good job, I want use CODEX in my project. So how should I handle this problem. Please give me some advises.
> > >
> > > Best,
> > >
> > >     Song Li
> > >
> > >
> > > -------------------------------
> > > BGI Tech Solution Co., Ltd.
> > > Email: li....@bgitechsolution.com
> > > Tel: +86 134 2874 7105
